hooks.command:
command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */js/dc-signal.js) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; today=$(date +%Y%m%d); vs=$(grep -rhoE 'dc-signal[.]js[?]v=[0-9]+' --include='*.html' . | sed 's/.*v=//' | sort -u); n=$(printf '%s
' "$vs" | grep -c .); if [ "$n" -eq 1 ] && [ "$vs" = "$today" ]; then exit 0; fi; printf 'STOP: js/dc-signal.js changed but the HTML cache-buster was not bumped to today (%s).
vercel.json serves /(.*).(css|js) as max-age=31536000, immutable, so every visitor keeps the OLD file and this edit reaches nobody.
HTML currently points at: %s
Bump ?v= to %s across every .html file (run /bump-signal), then re-check.
' "$today" "$(printf '%s' "$vs" | tr '
' ' ')" "$today" >&2; exit 2

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$c" in *scripts/deploy.sh*) exit 0;; esac; printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE 'vercel([^|;&]*)(--prod|deploy)' || exit 0; echo 'REFUSING: directcare.ai deploys only through ./scripts/deploy.sh (see DEPLOY.md). That script refuses to ship off main, behind origin, with a dirty tree, or from a checkout holding a stale .vercel link. A raw vercel deploy from the wrong tree reverted production on 2026-08-30 and again on 2026-09-02. Print the command for the user to run instead.' >&2; exit 2
